name: Merit-Based Undergraduate Scholarship
description: Awarded to undergraduate students based on academic excellence and financial need.

criteria.name: Academic Excellence
criteria.description: GPA and course rigor. 4.0 is perfect, < 3.0 is ineligible.

criteria.name: Financial Need
criteria.description: Annual household income. < $50k is high need.

criteria.name: Personal Statement
criteria.description: Quality of essay and alignment with goals.
